name: What is the difference between custom and pre-fabricated bathroom countertops?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between custom and pre-fabricated bathroom countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom bathroom countertops are designed and cut precisely to your bathroom's exact dimensions and specifications, offering unlimited options for materials, edge profiles, and sink cutouts. This allows for a truly unique and seamless fit. Pre-fabricated countertops, on the other hand, are pre-cut to standard sizes and shapes, offering a more budget-friendly and quicker installation option. While pre-fabricated options limit customization, they can be ideal for standard vanity sizes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom countertops are precisely made to your specifications, offering full customization. Pre-fabricated countertops are standard sizes, more affordable, and quicker to install, but limit design options.
